description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to transactional state configuration and factory creation within the Orleans framework, specifically in the Transactions.Abstractions namespace.

classes.name: TransactionalStateConfiguration
classes.description: A class implementing configuration details for transactional state, including state name, storage name, and supported roles.

methods.name: TransactionalStateConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor initializing the transactional state configuration with provided settings and supported roles.

methods.name: StateName
methods.description: Property returning the name of the transactional state.

methods.name: StorageName
methods.description: Property returning the storage name associated with the transactional state.

methods.name: SupportedRoles
methods.description: Property indicating roles supported by the transactional state configuration.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Method in the factory interface to create a transactional state instance for a given configuration.
